## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

solidity_test calls the shared helper. forge uses the Nix solc offline (the existing solc bug), and HOME is pinned, so ~/.foundry and svm under $HOME are never read (spec §4).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An unchanged solidity_test is a hit on the second run
- [ ] forge never reads or downloads anything under the user's home
